description: Common enum/lookup values for interpreting API responses. Use these to decode IDs in task, asset, and other records.

taskRecordTypes.description: Tasks can be templates (PM definitions) or actual work orders. Always filter by template field for accurate counts.

template.true: PM Template - a reusable definition/schedule, NOT an actual work order. Typically has createdDate=0 and due=0.
template.false: Work Order - an actual task instance that can be assigned, tracked, and completed.

filtering.overdueCount: Only count tasks where template=false/0 AND status=0 AND due>0 AND due<currentTimestamp
filtering.openCount: Only count tasks where template=false/0 AND status=0
filtering.note: Template field may be boolean (true/false) or numeric (1/0) depending on API response

usage.example: When a task has type=6, it means "Work Request"
usage.templateNote: CRITICAL: Always filter template=false when counting actual work orders. Templates are PM definitions, not work.
usage.note: Custom statuses (statusID) are account-specific workflow states beyond the basic complete/incomplete
